question: ap1
prompt:
Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Pulse-chase stimulation with time-resolved AP-1 and chromatin readouts
ideas.description: Deliver a transient stimulus (e.g., a brief cytokine, growth-factor, or drug pulse), wash it out, and then track AP-1 protein levels, AP-1 motif accessibility (ATAC-seq), and target-gene expression over many days. Memory is supported if accessibility at AP-1-bound enhancers and the primed transcriptional response persist long after the AP-1 proteins themselves and the original signal have decayed.

ideas.title: Single-cell lineage tracing of AP-1 state heritability
ideas.description: Use expressed DNA barcodes (e.g., Rewind/Watermelon-style clone tracking) combined with single-cell RNA-seq or a live AP-1 reporter to ask whether sister cells and clonal descendants share AP-1 activity levels. Quantifying how the correlation of AP-1 state between relatives decays with generations gives a direct measurement of the memory timescale and whether it is heritable versus transient.

ideas.title: Degron-based acute removal to separate maintenance from establishment
ideas.description: Tag endogenous FOS/JUN family members with an auxin or dTAG degron so AP-1 can be eliminated acutely at chosen times: before, during, or long after a priming stimulus. If removal after priming erases the retained accessibility and the faster/stronger secondary response, AP-1 is actively maintaining the memory rather than merely establishing it.

ideas.title: Restimulation challenge assays quantifying the memory benefit
ideas.description: Compare naive versus previously primed cells in a second challenge (same stimulus, a different stimulus, or a drug-resistance assay) and measure response latency, amplitude, fraction of responding cells, and cell-fate outcome. A genuine memory mechanism should produce a quantitatively faster or larger response that scales with prior AP-1 activation and is abolished by AP-1 perturbation.

ideas.title: Targeted AP-1 writing and erasing at specific enhancers
ideas.description: Use dCas9-fused AP-1 activation domains or dominant-negative A-FOS/engineered motif deletions at candidate enhancers to install or remove AP-1 occupancy in the absence of any stimulus. Sufficiency (synthetic AP-1 recruitment alone creates a long-lived primed state) plus necessity (motif deletion blocks memory at that locus but not globally) is the strongest causal test, and pairing it with CUT&RUN for cofactors and histone marks reveals the molecular carrier of the memory.
